title: Cartan Equation Solution — Spin-Torsion Coupling
plaintext:
EINSTEIN-CARTAN TORSION SOLUTION
================================

  T¹₁₂ = 1.015703    T¹₁₃ = 0.000014    T²₂₃ = 0.000009

|T| = 2.0238e+0 m⁻¹
λ (coupling) = -9.8962
σ (spin density) = 2.3432e-3 J·s/m³
